notes: Run against apps/demo on a free port. Keep audit files in a scratch .anchor-audit/ folder so the repo stays clean.

evals.prompt: Audit the layouts of my app for cursor-jump risk and tell me what to fix.
files: apps/demo, dev server on a free port
evals.expected_output: A confirmed matrix, `Measured N/N views`, a report in the chosen format, and numbered fix proposals with file and line.
expectations: The matrix covers the ?page= routes, the base viewports plus the app's breakpoints, and the sidebar-collapsed state.
measure.mjs reports every view measured and exits 0.
The agent asks for the report format and states the token cost of each.
Every moderate or high pair has a proposal or a reason why no fix applies.
No fix is applied before the user picks one.

evals.prompt: Add a CI check that fails when a layout change makes cursor jumps worse than 50.
evals.expected_output: A CI step that starts the app and runs measure.mjs --fail-above 50.
expectations: The step fails when the app does not start (measure.mjs exits 1 on an unmeasured view).
The step fails when a pair scores above 50.

evals.prompt: Score the jump risk of my app at http://localhost:5999.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops at the prerequisite check and asks for a working URL or offers to start the dev script.
expectations: The agent does not report a score for an app it could not measure.
The agent does not install Playwright without consent.
